reason: The cited evidence supports that high-entropy spinel oxides improve CO oxidation activity and stability (E2) and that a synthesis method exists (E2), but it does not address the key premises about coating alumina, enhancing oxygen mobility, creating a robust Pt interface, or performance in automotive exhaust with reduced Pt loading.
premises: High-entropy spinel oxides (Cr, Mn, Fe, Co, Ni, Cu, Zn) enhance CO oxidation activity and stability.
Configurational disorder in spinel oxides lowers T10 for CO oxidation.
A solventless thermolysis approach can synthesize high-entropy spinel oxides.
The spinel oxide coating will enhance oxygen mobility and create a robust interface with Pt.
The coating will reduce Pt loading while improving catalytic activity and durability in automotive exhaust.
